results.title: Claude Code & Agent Teams: What Roles Actually Work for Vibecoding in the Cloud? : Vibecoding Discussion Forums | Product Hunt
results.content:
Title: Claude Code & Agent Teams: What Roles Actually Work for Vibecoding in the Cloud? : Vibecoding Discussion Forums | Product Hunt
### Product Forums. # Claude Code & Agent Teams: What Roles Actually Work for Vibecoding in the Cloud? I just finished my first cloud project using Claude Code and I ran five different agents:. It took two months to get the roles right-figuring out what each agent should and shouldn't handle, and making sure they coordinate smoothly. My lesson: Agentic teams only work when each role is laser-focused and boundaries are clear. Is anyone else using Claude Code (or similar tools) to build with multiple agents in a vibecoding workflow? - What agent roles or setups have been most (or least) effective? - How did you decide which tasks were "agent-perfect" and which needed your hands-on guidance? Would love to swap stories, wins, and fails as we figure out the boundaries of agentic coding together! But for some technical SEO tasks it helps when the agent doesn't have to do all the steps (would take too long) and instead calls out to something more efficient like a command line tool or MCP. That said: do you see an advantage from having these specific agent definitions vs just prompting Claude Code directly? That was an unexpected advantage of the agent concept for me. The biggest surprise for me has been how much coordination overhead matters — if roles overlap even a little, agents trip over each other. In my experiments (with Claude Code and also Growstack’s AI agents), the most effective setup has been:. Engineer agent for pure code generation/refactoring. QA agent for test cases and bug surface. My takeaway: agents crush it on repetitive or well-bounded tasks, but vision + tradeoffs stay human for now. Curious — did you find any workflows where handoff between agents actually worked better than human-to-agent? I've worked on agents that provide text output and also voice agents. For voice agents I've found that models which are faster and talk to the point have helped me a lot Because I tried GPT5, and other Deep LLMs also but they respond with too long context and for this that was too much. ### Productivity. ### AI Agents. ### Trending products.
